title: Why deep reading beats scattered lookup
summary: Reading improves faster when the learner follows one article through to the end instead of constantly breaking focus.
translation: 当学习者把一篇文章完整读完，而不是不断打断自己时，阅读能力提升会更快。

sentences.text: Scattered lookup creates the feeling of effort, but it rarely builds a full understanding of the article.
A guided reading flow gives the learner enough support without letting the article disappear behind too many tools.

grammarPoints.title: but 连接对比
grammarPoints.explanation: 先说 lookup 看起来很努力，再用 but 强调它通常不能带来完整理解。

difficultSentences.breakdown: 主句是 A guided reading flow gives the learner enough support，without 后面补充说明这种支持不会让文章被工具淹没。
